items: portable foldable solar panel(s) sized to balcony space
why: ChatGPT defines the battery-type balcony solar generator as panels charging a portable battery, and it asks the shopper to pick a goal and a budget (under $500, $500–1,000, over $1,000). That points to different sets for different situations: a compact Elite 30 V2 + 100 W, an AC180 + 200 W, or an Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W, all sold as single kits in BLUETTI's store and none shown as a ChatGPT card. Which set works depends on the station's solar input voltage and wattage window, the panel connector, and how much panel area the balcony can hold; grid-feeding plug-in solar isn't legal in California until Jan 1, 2027, so a battery kit is what these shoppers can actually buy now.
